t: You're looking at Crosby Hall, a medieval building on Cheyne Walk in Chelsea. Its Great Hall was built in 1466, but not here. It originally stood as Crosby Place on Bishopsgate, in the City of London, and was moved to this site in 1910. Today it forms part of a private residence, renamed Crosby Moran Hall in 2021. That name comes from its owner, Christopher Moran, a businessman and president of Co-operation Ireland. So a fifteenth-century hall from the City now stands on the bank of the Thames in Chelsea.
